tree.heading: Expedited appeals procedure
tree.text: The Secretary shall establish an expedited administrative appeals procedure under which persons may appeal an action of the Secretary, the applicable governing State official, or a certifying agent under this chapter that—

children.text: is inconsistent with the organic certification program established under this chapter.

tree.heading: Appeal of final decision
tree.text: A final decision of the Secretary under subsection (a) may be appealed to the United States district court for the district in which such person is located.

notes.text: Amendments1991—Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 102–237 substituted “district court for the district” for “District Court for the District”.
